title: E-numbers
lead: An E-number is an additive: something added to your food. The code stands in for the name — and it tells you nothing. BOTIA gives you the name back, so you can decide.
tap_hint: Tap an ingredient to see what it is
disclaimer: BOTIA reads what the label declares. Always check important information yourself.
robot_answers: Because each regulatory system may use its own codes, chemical names or terms. E numbers are the European system, while other markets may show a different code or the full name.
No. Authorisation means it meets current regulatory conditions for specific uses; the evidence may still be reviewed and the conditions may change.
Because E471 is an identification code for the additive. Depending on the market and labelling practice, the code, its name or both may appear.
